pitch_angle: Zero-chemical constructed wetland reed beds for decentralized rural farmstead wastewater.
pitch_subject: Story idea: Zero-chemical reed bed water recycling for rural farmsteads
pitch_body:
Hi Down To Earth Editorial Team,

I've been an avid reader of CSE's work on groundwater resilience and decentralized ecology for years.

I'm an ecological architect based in Vadodara. Over the past two seasons, our studio has been implementing zero-chemical constructed wetland reed beds for rural retreats and farmsteads—recycling 100% of greywater directly into aquifer recharge using local Phragmites root zones.

We've documented the installation costs, species selection, and BOD reduction into a clean visual case study:
https://www.anvitam.com/projects

Would you be open to seeing a short pitch draft for your upcoming sustainable habitat coverage?

Best,
Archana
Principal Architect, Anvitam
